title: Amazon Haul: Free Shipping with 3+ Items, $5 off Promo Code
body:
Deal: Amazon Haul: Free Shipping with 3+ Items, $5 off Promo Code

[foogle] any good things? looks like overpriced temu.
[yht] Any minimum purchase to apply for the $5 disc ?
[dufflover] Doesn't look like it. I just bought 3 little kitchen accessories delivered for $1.10 ($6.10 -5)
Definitely would've cost me than that off Ali no matter the cashback lol.
[Save 50 Cent] https://amzn.asia/d/05ppOnlN
This is good for a dollar if you are trying to reach $5 spend or you can have 5 of them for free if you don’t need anything.
[Save 50 Cent] You’re welcome.. probably worth posting as its own deal but it is my bedtime. If someone is staying up late, please post and take the free internet points.
[jaboday423] No longer available, probably OzBargained!
[sphinxy] Thanks - very timely.
My kid accidentally broke my wife's water bottle.
So I got a clear water bottle, body silicone scrubber and kinetic rings (son just returned from camp and broke his gift from questicon 🫠)
[darkmoss] it must be targeted. i don't have free shipping with 3+ items
[RichardL] It's in the Amazon Haul banner
😃 Free shipping from 3+ items | 😱 Save 5% on 6+ items | 🤩 Save 10% on 10+ items
[RichardL] I just checked incognito and the banner is still showing.
[darkmoss] @RichardL: even the banner you're talking about says 'from 3 plus items' … doesn't work for 3 items
[RichardL] @darkmoss: Can confirm it's free shipping when you add 3 items to cart
[darkmoss] @RichardL: can confirm it isn't , i added 3 items in haul richard. it's selected items only and targeted
[BargainsGrabber] @darkmoss: I can see free shipping on my end too. Can you send the link of the product that you’re looking at?
[ozBfrugal] The reason you're not seeing free on 3+ items is due to the shipping location. Change it to a capital city postcode and you'll see the 3+. For regional locations it will be 6+. Sorry you're getting negged but you are right it's "targeted" and the banner "from 3+" will catch people out.
[VantageXL] Thanks. Just bought another mini shipping container for 80 cents total by adding two of these $0.52 items to my cart.
The Amazon listing hides the logos of the shipping companies but they’re still included on the actual items. For example, you can see what the Maersk one looks like in this video .
[codaroma] handy low cost top up item
https://www.amazon.com.au/dp/B0GYPXK6ZZ
[BargainsGrabber] BG’s tip: it doesn’t need to be 3 items from overseas Amazon Haul items. You can also add an item or 2 that’s shipped by Amazon AU, and one overseas item, and it’s still eligible for the free shipping. Tho the $5 discount will only apply proportionately to the overseas item only
[BargainsGrabber] Love it when I get negged lol
Here’s the proof: https://files.ozbargain.com.au/upload/399144/130854/img_6384…
[amsaini15] Slightly off topic, anyone knows why there is longer wait for Temu 40-50% cashback offers? Are they testing market if people will continue to buy without cashback?
[jaboday423] It would be interesting to see links to some of the items the OzBargain community would be placing orders for.
[BargainsGrabber] This for the lolz
https://amzn.asia/d/09XRAycD
[ozBfrugal] This is dependent on the shipping location. For example, postcodes 0870 (Alice Springs) and 4870 (Cairns), you will need to have 6 or more items instead of 3 or more.
[Nekonekoni] No wonder why mine is showing 6 items too… Hobart here
